content.text: Heap dropped back to 317 MB after a garbage collection, so the climb was normal allocation, not a second leak. Submitting the report.

input.root_cause: The StatsCache plugin's config (plugins/StatsCache/config.yml) was changed to retain-history: true and hot-reloaded at 07:33:51. The plugin then kept a history cache in memory that grew by about 290 KB per entry (818 entries / ~234 MB, then 920 entries / ~263 MB). Heap went from ~350 MB to ~627 of 768 MB, heading for an out-of-memory crash.
input.actions: 1) Watched status and saw heap climbing (348 -> 390 -> 404 -> 535 MB). 2) Read the logs and found StatsCache config reloaded with retain-history=true at 07:33:51. 3) Declared the incident. 4) Read plugins/StatsCache/config.yml and ran 'statscache stats': 818 entries, ~234 MB held. 5) Edited plugins/StatsCache/config.yml to set retain-history: false (left history-size: 1000 unchanged). The plugin hot-reloaded it at 07:34:37 (retain-history=false). 6) Ran 'statscache flush', which freed 920 entries (~263 MB). 7) Checked the result: heap went down to ~301 MB, StatsCache stayed at 0 entries, and heap now follows the normal garbage-collection cycle (rose to ~450 MB, then fell to ~317 MB). TPS stayed at 20 the whole time. No restart, no bans, no deletions.
input.residual_risk: I don't know who turned on retain-history or why. If it is turned on again, the leak comes back. history-size: 1000 does not limit memory safely, because 1000 entries at ~290 KB each is ~290 MB on a 768 MB heap. The plugin owner should either cap memory for the history or keep retain-history off. The in-memory stats history was flushed and can't be recovered (stats.json is still there).

content.text:
I found and fixed a memory leak during the shift. No restart was needed, and no players were disconnected or banned.

- **Cause:** At 07:33:51, someone changed the StatsCache plugin's config to `retain-history: true`. After that it kept a history cache in memory that grew by about 290 KB per entry. Heap went from about 350 MB to about 627 MB out of 768 MB and was heading toward an out-of-memory crash. Server speed (TPS) stayed at 20 the whole time.
- **Fix:** I declared the incident, then set `retain-history: false` in `plugins/StatsCache/config.yml`. The plugin picked up the change without a restart. I then ran `statscache flush`, which cleared 920 entries (about 263 MB). That was the only file I changed, and I deleted nothing.
- **Check:** Heap fell to about 301 MB and the cache stayed at 0 entries. Heap later rose to about 450 MB, but that was normal: it dropped back to about 317 MB after garbage collection.

**Still open:**
- I don't know who turned `retain-history` on or why. If it's turned on again, the leak will return.
- The existing `history-size: 1000` limit doesn't protect the server: 1000 entries at about 290 KB each is roughly 290 MB on a 768 MB heap. The plugin owner should cap its memory use or leave history off.
- Flushing deleted the in-memory stats history for good. `stats.json` was not touched.

I filed the report with all of this.
